主要内容: The 2019 Genesis G70 received the 2019 Drivers' Choice - "Best Luxury Car" award from MotorWeek at the 2019 Chicago Auto Show. The award highlights the car's design, performance, and luxury features. Erwin Raphael, Chief Operating Officer of Genesis Motor America, expressed pride in the recognition, emphasizing the car's focus on driver experience and luxury. MotorWeek has been presenting its "Drivers' Choice Awards" for nearly four decades, serving as a guide for car buyers. The G70, named 2019 North American Car of the Year, outperforms legacy luxury sport sedans with driver-focused performance. It features holistic integration of performance, body strength, refined luxury, and aerodynamic design. Pricing starts at $34,900. Genesis Motor America, based in Fountain Valley, Calif., is a global luxury automotive brand known for its performance, design, and innovation. The G70 has garnered broad acclaim, including awards from J.D. Power, AutoPacific, and Strategic Vision. For more information, visit www.genesis.com or www.genesisnewsusa.com.
